data.axis_semantics: legacy matrix.reasoning_depth stores an UPDATE-ROUND LABEL, never reasoning; actual update_rounds recorded in every trial
data.generation_policy: no structural/model-based resampling; all draws retained
data.legal_candidate_inputs: only float32 paired train arrays, legal train episodes/labels; inference timestamp/handle/write observation/value and query observation; no teacher matrices, nonce, identity, flags or target handle
data.private_entropy: five independent256-bit runner nonces, realized after preregistration, separate from model seed; private artifact inaccessible to candidate imports/inputs; same arrays across roles

decision_policy: KEEP new screening cohort only if legal boundary, learning gates and all dense-reference competence gates pass. If any gate fails, retain and diagnose; examine at least two distinct justified alternatives prospectively within program, not automatic broad family falsification. Strong classical success is permitted and must not be weakened. No architecture/economics claim; source-identical memory mechanism, adverse variant and frozen fresh final remain later scope. A crash/deadline/cap stops all unstarted roles and preserves everything, no retry.

diagnosis_gates.interpretation: learning of an observation map must matter on fresh identities; this gate cannot prove neural learning is intrinsically required or transfer beyond this task

diagnostics.private_boundary: static source/import audit plus stripped inputs; local evaluator not an OS security sandbox or externally blinded final
diagnostics.raw_predictions: per query top1 record/value, max cosine, chosen answer and truth/stratum revealed only after answer
reproducibility: classical grid scores and chosen threshold
allocation/ingest/index/update/query logical state and device/RSS costs

implementation_scope: minimal new protected generator/evaluator/candidate core and role aliases; prospective generalization of research scope/schema to this cohort, runner-private entropy and full-wall compute charging only new studies; all historical charges/plans/results unchanged
next_alternatives: if transport/competence fails consider CCA/whitening transport and supervised contrastive/in-batch ranking set loss, not merely more steps; choose next prospective contract from diagnosis
question: Does legal learned view alignment on fresh identities yield competent dense Transformer/pointer controls and a discriminating task relative to untrained/shuffled and strong classical transport, with separate absence and ranking?

recipe.alignment_loss: mean squared error paired query->write observation
recipe.architecture: shared query view transport: Linear64->64 residual plus Linear64->128,GELU,Linear128->64; writes remain raw64; L2-normalized matching. No external weights. Dense control adds conventional two-layer nn.TransformerDecoder with width64,heads4,FF256,GELU,pre-norm,dropout0,self+cross dense softmax attention and dense cosine pointer. Output residual projections initially zero to preserve trained transport; fit contrastive set loss. Pointer/exact_nn omit decoder.
recipe.dense_set_loss: cross entropy over K normalized scores and one NULL score; fixed scale20, NULL cosine0.85; plus0.1*MSE decoded query versus normalized target write for known queries
recipe.encoder_during_dense_set_fit: frozen after supervised alignment; decoder trained, no value shortcuts or labels in query
recipe.exact_nn: source-identical complete query transport fit; weights must match pointer exactly, full scan cosine instead of dense softmax; own repeated fit fully charged
recipe.kernel: RBF Nyström transport,512 first training-query landmarks, all4096 pairs, float64 primal ridge; bandwidths[0.25,0.5,1.0], ridge[0.0001,0.01]; minimal reserved512 train-only MSE, deterministic grid order; all search/landmarks/fit charged
recipe.raw: zero-fit raw-space cosine, same update/absence interface
recipe.ridge: query-to-write ridge with intercept; all4096 legal pairs, choose minimal MSE on reserved512 training-only pairs, fixed ascending grid ties first
recipe.selection: last fixed optimizer step; no checkpoint, dev/hyperparameter adaptation or seed selection; all outcomes retained
recipe.shuffled: same transport code/initialization/batches/steps, a single fixed runner-seed permutation of positive write correspondences; train set controls not relabeled
recipe.threshold_selection: training-only calibration across K32/128/512,3 episodes each,64 queries each. Prefer candidates satisfying known false abstention<=.02 and UNKNOWN>=.95; then maximal full-answer accuracy, larger UNKNOWN, lower threshold. If infeasible maximal full-answer accuracy with same ties. Never dev selection. Same finite calibration for ALL controls.
recipe.untrained: source-identical query transport initialization and pointer, zero updates

uncertainty: five independent seed/data units; equal cell means; paired two-sided97.5% Student-t df4 for two primary effects, familywise95%; all seed minima and95% descriptive uncertainty for others; episodes/questions not independent replicas
